title: List backlog tasks
description: List the tasks in the PROJECT'S BACKLOG — the queue this task was picked from. Use it before enqueueing work, to check whether it is already queued, and to see what depends on what. Titles and metadata only; call read_task for one task's full text. Filter by status: queued, claimed, running, verifying, review, landed, failed, parked.

status.description: Only tasks in this status. Omit for all of them.

examples: what else is in the backlog
is there already a task for the board columns
